name: llm-health
description: Local-first health intelligence for Codex: event-driven result reviews, diagnostic gaps, least-harm protocols, medication collateral-damage review, research queues, and de-identified v2 dashboard integration.

interface.shortDescription: Review health data, close diagnostic gaps, queue research, and keep health artifacts private
interface.longDescription: Bundle the llm-health workflow for Codex: ingest de-identified health observations, trigger quick reviews, suggest diagnostic-gap and test-candidate cards, plan deeper capture-aware research, compare least-harm options, review medication collateral damage, integrate de-identified health-assessment-v2 data, and export safe artifacts without raw identifiers.
defaultPrompt: Review the latest de-identified health results and tell me what changed.
Find diagnostic gaps and suggest high-leverage test candidates to discuss.
Queue deep research for flagged markers using mainstream, frontier, edge, contrarian, capture, and risk lenses.
Review medication collateral damage and lower-collateral alternatives.
Sync de-identified health-assessment-v2 data into llm-health review cards.
